body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Four test files in plugins/adlc-cursor/test manually invoke mkdtempSync and guard removals in 77 try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In plugins/adlc-cursor/test/build-gate.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept the t parameter from test(...).
   - Replace mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'cursor-bg-')) with tmp(t, 'cursor-bg-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In plugins/adlc-cursor/test/mcp-roots-proxy-lifecycle.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
   - Replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'cursor-mcp-lifecycle-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In plugins/adlc-cursor/test/mcp-wrapper.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
   - Replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'cursor-mcp-wrapper-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
4. In plugins/adlc-cursor/test/session-start.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
   - Replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'cursor-session-start-').
   - Remove manual try { ... } finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove plugins/adlc-cursor/test/build-gate.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-cursor/test/mcp-roots-proxy-lifecycle.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-cursor/test/mcp-wrapper.test.mjs, and plugins/adlc-cursor/test/session-start.test.mjs from the ALLOWLIST set (completely eradicating plugins/adlc-cursor from the allowlist!).
6. Verification:
   - node scripts/run-tests.mjs cursor exits 0 with all tests passing.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -E 'plugins/adlc-cursor/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 All 4 test files contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 4 test files.
- AC3 grep -E 'plugins/adlc-cursor/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.
- AC4 node scripts/run-tests.mjs cursor exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(adlc-cursor): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate try/finally blocks in Cursor tests
